title: No Béarla Series 1, Episode 1.
summary: The first episode of the Irish TV series No Bearla, in which native Irish speaker Manchan Magan travels around Ireland trying to get by using only Irish. It documents the highs and lows of the attempt.
why: Cited in threads on minority languages as a funny but sad look at how hard it is to live in Irish.

quote.text: No Béarla[1] is one of the saddest documentaries I've ever seen.
